snapshot.reason: An additional irrevocable undertaking has been secured for the pre-conditional voluntary general cash offer, increasing the probability of a successful take-private or acquisition.
snapshot.why_now: The joint announcement regarding the additional undertaking was released on October 22, 2026.
source_headlines: XIN YUAN ENT (01748): JOINT ANNOUNCEMENT ADDITIONAL IRREVOCABLE UNDERTAKING WITH RESPECT TO PRE-CONDITIONAL VOLUNTARY GENERAL CASH OFFER BY ICBC INTERNATIONAL CAPITAL LIMITED FOR AND ON BEHALF OF THE OFFEROR TO ACQUIRE ALL THE ISSUED SHARES OF THE COMPANY (OTHER THAN THOSE ALREADY OWNED AND/OR AGREED TO BE ACQUIRED BY THE OFFEROR AND/OR PARTIES ACTING IN CONCERT WITH IT)
